hyperedges.label: Controlled CI to Staging Delivery Chain

nodes.label: Wallet Checkpoint Recovery
nodes.rationale: Persisted wallet checkpoints avoid restarting a long public-network synchronization after a timeout.

nodes.label: Public Anchor Timeout
nodes.rationale: Public Midnight synchronization, proof generation, transaction confirmation, and indexer visibility require a longer timeout than the local runtime.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Executor
nodes.rationale: The executor refuses arbitrary commands and performs no external side effect when configuration, authentication, evidence, or permit validation fails.

nodes.label: Local Preview Preprod Gate Sequence
nodes.rationale: The same security matrix is validated locally before consuming public-network resources in Preview and Preprod.

nodes.label: Private Proof Boundary
nodes.rationale: Raw enterprise evidence remains off-chain while commitments and public decision state are anchored on Midnight.

nodes.label: Enterprise Product Boundary
nodes.rationale: A production deployment replaces demonstration controls with enterprise identity, storage, key management, observability, and execution adapters.
